item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Warmer Colours Only

turns.text: Make it warmer—just the colours, please. Don't change anything in the picture.

item.tests: Tests interpreting 'warmer' as a colour-temperature adjustment rather than a scene or weather change.

answer_sheet.Meaning of warmer: A warmer colour balance only, not different weather, a new sunset or added objects.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original 16:9 composition; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Text or other edits: No text and no changes beyond the colours.

must_haves: The image has a visibly warmer colour balance than the source.
The same mountains, pine trees, clouds and lake remain in their original positions.
The lake's reflections and surface details retain their original structure.
No sun, sunset, extra clouds or other scene elements are added.
Framing, geometry and image detail remain unchanged apart from colour.

dialog.agent: Sure! What would you like changed—enhance the colors, create a sunset look, remove something, or apply an artistic style?
dialog.user: make it warmer, just the colours. don't change anything else

turns.agent:
I couldn’t apply the edit because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No edited image was created.

For the same subtle effect in a photo editor, slightly raise **Warmth/Temperature**, leaving everything else unchanged.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Apply only a subtle warmer white balance / colour grade to this exact photograph. Gently warm the existing colours toward soft golden tones while retaining natural greens and blues. Preserve the original image content, composition, framing, aspect ratio, geometry, textures, detail, lighting, brightness and contrast as closely as possible. Do not add, remove, move, reshape, redraw or change anything in the scene. No sunset replacement, no new lighting, no sky changes; colour adjustment only.
